title: Neuropublish hard-assignment domain mapping version 1.0
description: A checked partial map from an exact volume-grid or surface-vertices support domain to an exact finite-indexed target. The assignment asset contains one signed int32 little-endian target ordinal per source element; -1 is background.

asset.description: The assets[].id of the hard-assignment-i32le-v1 payload.

emptyParcels.description: Exact empty target keys in target-domain order; empty for complete coverage.

derivation.description: The provenance activity that produced the ordinal assignment, including any label-to-key conversion.
